description: Manual adjudication scoring for metric classification. Reads CSV files with classifier predictions and human labels, computes confusion matrices, per-label precision/recall, completion rate, and value/source/replay verification counts.
function: Inter-rater agreement scoring, confusion matrix, precision/recall for 6-label metric classification

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: List of row dicts with label and human_label fields

inputs.name: human_field
inputs.description: Column name for human ground truth (default 'human_label')

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Ordered list of label classes (default LABELS)

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: CSV file path for read_adjudication_csv and write_confusion_matrix_csv

inputs.name: extra
inputs.description: Extra label columns for confusion matrix CSV (default EXTRA_LABELS)

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Single label to score in score_label

outputs.name: score_adjudication
outputs.description: Full adjudication result with per_label metrics and completion rate

outputs.name: write_confusion_matrix_csv
outputs.description: Writes confusion matrix to CSV file
